deep_dive.title: Open-Ended CT Volume Segmentation with Weak Supervision from Language
deep_dive.abstract: We introduce a method for training a text-conditioned segmentation model for CT scans, which combines voxel-level supervision with coarse but scalable slice-level supervision from reports. We extract, from a large database of scan-report pairs, descriptions of findings with indices of slices where those findings occur. We then finetune a general-purpose 2D image segmentation model, SAM3, with standard segmentation losses from strongly labeled data and with a slice-level classification loss from the extracted weak supervision. Our results on the ReXGroundingCT dataset illustrate that this strategy improves the segmentation dice score: from an 8% relative gain when there are 1000 fully labeled volumes to 22% when there are 250 fully labeled volumes.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: text-conditioned 3D CT segmentation, open-vocab segmentation with weak language supervision

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: This paper trains a text-conditioned 3D CT segmentation model by combining voxel-level supervision with scalable slice-level weak supervision from reports, improving Dice over 22% with limited labels.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对医学CT体数据中人工标注昂贵且难以覆盖开放词汇的问题，本文提出一种利用语言报告进行弱监督的开放式分割方法。方法在2D分割模型SAM3基础上结合切片级分类损失与体素级监督，从扫描-报告对中自动提取描述与切片索引。实验表明，在ReXGroundingCT数据集上，该方法在标注数据极少时也能带来8%至22%的相对Dice提升，为开放词汇三维分割提供了低成本可扩展的新思路。

quick_skim.title: StructureGS: Structure-aware Gaussian Splatting for Articulated Object Reconstruction
quick_skim.abstract: Reconstructing articulated objects with multiple movable parts is essential for understanding object structure and enabling physical interaction. However, this reconstruction task poses significant challenges due to the entanglement of geometry, appearance, and motion parameters during optimization. Existing methods rely primarily on photometric supervision, which commonly fails to disentangle these interdependent components, resulting in poor part decomposition with blurred boundaries and geometric artifacts. To address this limitation, we introduce StructureGS, a reconstruction framework for articulated objects that integrates structure-aware guidance into 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our approach leverages oriented bounding boxes of object parts to enforce two key structural properties: spatial coherence, which constrains each part's geometry to remain compact and spatially coherent within its designated region, and structural connectivity, which enforces physically plausible contact relationships between adjacent parts. These properties are realized through structure-aware losses that inject explicit structural constraints into the optimization process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in articulated object reconstruction, producing high-quality results with well-defined part geometries.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Structure-aware Gaussian Splatting with part decomposition; supports part-level semantic reasoning for open-vocabulary 3D understanding

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: StructureGS adds structure-aware guidance to 3D Gaussian Splatting via oriented bounding boxes for articulated object decomposition, improving part boundaries and geometry, and enabling part-level semantic reasoning.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 铰接物体的重建常因几何、外观与运动参数纠缠而出现部件分解不清、边界模糊等问题。本文提出StructureGS，在三维高斯泼溅优化中引入结构感知引导，以有向包围盒约束各部分运动与几何，使部件分解与重建联合进行。实验验证该方法能有效改善铰接物体的部件边界与几何质量，优于仅依赖光度监督的现有方法。该工作为结构感知的三维高斯泼溅在部件级语义推理与开放词汇场景理解中的应用提供了基础。
